title: The 10 Best Cordless Pole Saws
subtitle: Battery-powered pole saws and 2-in-1 pole chainsaws for trimming high branches, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless pole saw cuts branches high in a tree from the ground, no ladder needed. We ranked 10 best-sellers from Greenworks, EGO, CRAFTSMAN, WORX and budget brands on rating, review volume and features (12 ft or more reach, a battery in the box, auto oiling and detaching for handheld use).
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

avoid.name: 2-IN-1 Cordless 8-Inch Pole Saw and Chainsaw for DeWALT 20V MAX Battery, 1200W Brushless Motor
avoid.flag: Model number is a product description; 1,200 W claim
avoid.verdict: A DEWALT-battery pole saw whose 'model number' is just 'Pole Saws for Tree Trimming' and whose 1,200 W claim isn't backed by any runtime or cut count.
reasons: The model number field reads 'Pole Saws for Tree Trimming', so there's no traceable model for parts, bars or chains later.
It claims a 1,200 W brushless motor on a single 20V battery and never says how many cuts or minutes you get per charge.
It's rated 4.3 stars on 225 reviews; the CRAFTSMAN and Greenworks pole saws state their reach, runtime or oiling and have thousands of reviews.

buyers_guide.q: How much reach do I need?
buyers_guide.a: Add your height and arm reach (about 7 to 8 ft) to the shaft length. A 9 to 10 ft pole reaches limbs around 15 to 16 ft off the ground; 13 to 16 ft poles get you higher. Never cut directly overhead.
Dedicated pole saws balance better on the pole. 2-in-1 models detach into a mini chainsaw for ground cleanup, which is handy for small yards.
6 to 8 inches handles branches up to about 4 to 6 inches. 10-inch bars like the EGO and WORX cut a bit thicker.
The chain needs bar oil. Auto oilers feed it while you cut; without one you'll oil by hand and wear chains faster.
Wear eye protection and a hard hat, stand to the side of the branch, and stay at least 10 feet from power lines. Hire a pro for limbs near wires or over the house.
